facts.value: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam are the three most popular Abrahamic faiths.

facts.value: The Baháʼí Faith claims to be a world religion from the line of major Abrahamic religions.

facts.value: Founded in 19th-century Iran, it teaches the unity of all great religious traditions as the progressive unfolding of one religion.

facts.value: The Baháʼí Faith accepts all of the prophets of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam as well as additional prophets including Krishna, Buddha, Zoroaster, and its founder Bahá'u'lláh.
